title: Text: Aunt Sharon ↔ Anthony Fenech

searchText: hello, we were in your area but thought you were sleeping. mom said she takes you to the airport thursday, so we will pick up the red car friday to take in and change the oil. when do you come back to michigan from that trip? hope you are doing good! 👍🏻 💕  aunt sharon
